sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently short-circuits when any link in the chain is nil
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through layers of connection, but if any link is absent, the entire reach silently resolves to nothing.

sketches.mechanism: An interface with a single method that no class implements — the method exists as a contract, but no one fulfills it
sketches.resonance: A promise defined in structure that no one in the world has ever kept.

sketches.mechanism: Pattern matching in receive with an 'after' timeout clause — the process waits for a message that never arrives, then gives up
sketches.resonance: Waiting for a reply that never comes, until time itself becomes the answer.
sketches.draft:
defmodule Waiting do
  def listen do
    receive do
      {:reply, _} -> :ok
    after
      :infinity -> :silence
    end
  end
end
